column1: # VENDORED.tsv - manifest for skills-vendor.sh (the OPS skill-mount mechanism).
# OPS mounts portable technique skills rather than carrying a drifting fork of
# each. The skill repos cloned under PROJECTS/ are the source of truth; this file
# lists which skill dirs are mirrored into SKILLS/ and from where. Edit a vendored
# skill at its source repo, then run `skills-vendor.sh sync` to refresh the mirror
# here. Never hand-edit the mirrored SKILLS/<name>/ dirs; the sync overwrites them.
# Format: one row per skill, tab-separated:
#   <name><TAB><source-dir relative to ~/OPS/PROJECTS>
# The mirror lands at ~/OPS/SKILLS/<name>/. Lines starting with # and blank lines
# are ignored. The drift gate is `skills-vendor.sh --check`, wired into
# verify-ops.sh (DRIFT = FAIL, MISSING = WARN).
# To mount the default source, clone it under PROJECTS/ first:
#   git clone https://github.com/Exploitacious/agent-skills.git \
#     ~/OPS/PROJECTS/Exploitacious/agent-skills
# then run: skills-vendor.sh sync
# This ships only the PUBLIC default source (Exploitacious/agent-skills, MIT).
# Add rows for an org or private source of your own below, one per skill.
# Source repo: Exploitacious/agent-skills (public, MIT) — the portable set.
